message.content: {"steps":[{"id":"s1","agent_id":"coder","description":"On this machine, run a short Python script that measures how long it takes to compute sum(range(1,10_000_001)). Use time.perf_counter() and perform 5 independent timed runs (not micro-benchmarked inside loops) to capture variability. Also record the Python version and a timestamp. Verify the computed sum equals 50000005000000. Write the results as JSON to sum_1_to_10000000_timing.json with fields: times_seconds (list), mean_seconds, median_seconds, min_seconds, max_seconds, python_version, timestamp, verified_sum (the computed sum), and the exact measurement code used.
